additional_info.subject: RE: ID0384722-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001812] Strip light issue CRM:00641000706
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope you are doing well.
Regarding the reported issue at the charging station, we have noted that part of the light strip is not functioning. Additionally, we have identified errors related to the cooling system that also need attention. To address these concerns, we recommend planning a site intervention. Below are the details for troubleshooting both issues:
1.
Light Strip Issue
As part of the light strip is without lighting, we suggest referring to the attached schematic for troubleshooting.
If everything checks out, please replace the indicated part for testing. Kindly carry the necessary part during the site visit.
2.
Cooling System Errors
DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Lvlswitch
This error indicates that the coolant level in the tank is below the critical level and needs to be topped up.
DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump
(Error Code 20)
This points to a potential leakage detected in the charger. It's important to prioritize this issue, as a leakage could damage other components if not resolved.
During the site visit, please check for any leakage around the cooling unit and the main fan at the top of the charger.
And
Keep Cooling liquid with you in case cooling unit require top-up.
Additional Notes:
If you require NOC remote assistance during the intervention, please inform us at least 2 days before the visit to ensure proper planning and support.
We appreciate your attention to these issues and look forward to assisting you further.
Best regards,
Abhinav Malokar
eMobility Tech Support Team
